sources.text:
One of Ireland's most spectacular routes is the Sky Road, a 16km loop that skirts the Connemara coastline and scene of many a breathtaking sunset over the Atlantic.

From the Sky Road you'll get fine views along the Connemara coastline, while the steep ascent along the coast provide wonderful vantage points for panoramic views of Clifden Bay and its collection of islands.
